title: Combine two elements
detail: Drag two bubbles onto the board and drop one on the other.

title: Find a new element
detail: There are more than four. Fire and Air make the first of them.

title: Make a spellbook
detail: A spellbook turns matter into magic. Grow something, then give it Light.

title: Find a school of magic
detail: Light, shone on one of the elements, opens a school.

title: Shape your first cantrip
detail: Combine a school with an element it likes. The spellbook has to come first.

title: Learn your first spell
detail: Drop a spell on your spellbook. Learning it costs gold.

title: Reach level 2
detail: New discoveries and finished quests both earn experience. Keep making things.

title: See a visitor through
detail: Sooner or later someone turns up with something on their mind. Hear them out to the end.

title: Discover 15 things
detail: Anything new counts. Try the pairs that seem least likely.

title: Learn a first-tier spell
detail: Combine a school with one of its own cantrips, then learn what comes of it. Some ask for materials on hand.

title: Find a component for a higher spell
detail: Stronger spells ask for rarer materials.

title: Make a person
detail: Mud, and a little Life to get it talking.

title: Become a Wizard
detail: A person and a spellbook, brought together.

title: Welcome a townsperson
detail: A job you discover becomes someone who arrives in town, looking for somewhere to work.

title: Buy a plot
detail: Your first job earns you a place in town. A plot is yours for a little gold.

title: Raise a building
detail: A townsperson's plan, the things it needs, and an evening to build it in.

title: Reach level 3
detail: Second-tier spells can be learned from there.

title: See five visitors through
detail: People keep arriving. Each one you hear out counts, however it goes.

title: Buy something from the shop
detail: The shelf turns over as you discover things. Buying is a shortcut to something you have not made.

title: Find three schools of magic
detail: Each school starts from a different pairing of elements.

title: Discover 60 things
detail: The further from the four elements, the stranger it gets.

title: Learn a second-tier spell
detail: A school and one of its first-tier spells make the next one up.

title: Learn spells from two schools
detail: One school is a habit. Two is an education.

title: Take up a second trade
detail: A person and the right tool or place make a job. The journal hints at each one.

title: Open the Market Stall
detail: The merchant's stall opens the shop. Raise it and the shelves are yours.

title: Spend an evening in town
detail: From dusk, spend the evening's time on a visitor or a call on a neighbour.

title: Enchant a building
detail: A learned spell, cast on a building that wants it, makes it shine for days.

title: Reach level 4
detail: Higher callings are waiting there.

title: Hold eight spells
detail: Found counts, learned or not. Every school has cantrips to shape.

title: Gather eight spell components
detail: Salt, silver, feathers and the like. Higher spells will not work without them.

title: Find all eight schools
detail: Some are made with Shadow, and one sits between Life and Death.

title: Discover 120 things
detail: By now most of them are things nobody has written down.

title: Make something six steps deep
detail: Count the combinations back to the four elements. Keep building on what you just made.

title: Rise to a higher calling
detail: Some jobs grow out of other jobs. A Wizard with the right thing in hand becomes something more.

title: Know five spells
detail: Learned, not only found. The spellbook has room.

title: Reach level 5
detail: Third-tier spells can be learned at the top.

title: See 15 visitors through
detail: The town knows where you live by now.

title: Hold four jobs
detail: Mundane or magic, they all count. The journal still has gaps.

title: Learn spells from three schools
detail: A third school, and a third way of looking at a problem.

title: Discover 200 things
detail: The shelves are getting crowded. Keep going.

title: Buy five things from the shop
detail: A regular, then. The shopkeeper has started keeping things back for you.

title: Learn a third-tier spell
detail: A school, one of its second-tier spells, and whatever materials it asks for.

title: Discover 300 things
detail: Nobody is counting but you. That is reason enough.

title: Learn spells from four schools
detail: Half of everything there is to know.

title: Hold three third-tier spells
detail: Found counts, learned or not. Each school keeps its best for last.

title: Make something ten steps deep
detail: A long way from Fire, Water, Earth and Air.
